Micah (PM): Quick sync — we need cross-team alignment on scope, SLA bands, and fallback behavior for the Adaptive Lite pilot. Customers expect a pilot in ~6 weeks. Can teams confirm constraints/reqs?
Anya (Eng): Quick Q — what are the target p50/p95 & max token length we should design for?
Micah (PM): Target p50 150ms, p95 600ms, tokens <= 512. Pilot = 3 mid-market customers. Open to adjust if infra/runtime says not feasible.
Devin (Runtime): 150ms p50 is optimistic on current 16G single-node configs. Realistic baseline: p50 ~200ms with aggressive batching. p95 will need either reserved capacity or fallback strategies.
Sara (Infra): We can reserve capacity for pilot. Need committed QPS numbers to size pools and estimate cost. Autoscale warm-up is ~2-3m per node.
Micah (PM): Rough QPS: 15 rps steady, bursts up to 60 rps. Is that enough detail?
Sara (Infra): With that: reserving 4 A100-like nodes should cover steady + short bursts, but we should plan a burst buffer and degraded fallback to protect latency SLOs.
Devin (Runtime): Fallback idea: overflow -> quantized variant (q4). Tradeoff: lower latency but quality drop. Perf quick sketch:
```
# rough perf numbers per node
A100-node: 12 rps @ p95 600ms (vanilla)
A100-node-q4: 25 rps @ p95 400ms (quantized)
```
Devin (Runtime): We'll run simulated traffic with real prompt samples to measure quality delta. Need prompt set from product.
Lia (Security): Heads up — pilot will need KMS integration + audit logs for customer data. If any PII is involved we must enable DLP hooks before hosted pilot. Private deploy increases compliance options but also onboarding time.
Anya (Eng): I'll own the eval harness and produce the prompt/regression set. Can we get a staging model artifact for quantized variant?
Devin (Runtime): Yes, we can produce q4 build and push to staging, but runtime needs model artifact + tokenization config by EOD Fri to include in canary.
ops-bot: Deploy scheduled: adaptive-lite-staging -> today 18:30 UTC. Rolling restart across runtime pool.
Micah (PM): Action items: Micah confirm QPS with customers; Sara to run cost + reserve plan; Devin to run fallback simulation and upload perf matrix; Anya to deliver prompt eval set; Lia to confirm KMS/DLP gating. Propose sync Tue 10:00am to lock scope.
Anya (Eng): :thumbsup: Tue 10 works for me.
Sara (Infra): I'll put estimated cost + reservation options into a short doc before the meeting.
Lia (Security): I'll review compliance checklist and flag any blockers pre-Tue.
Devin (Runtime): One ask — product, please prioritize a short set (~50) representative prompts covering edge cases (long context, system instructions, sensitive fields). That will make the fallback sim meaningful.
Micah (PM): Will do. Thanks all — will send calendar invite and a one-pager with proposed SLA bands + rollback criteria.
Sara (Infra): Also adding note: canary window recommendation = 30m with traffic ramping at 20%, 50%, 100%. Saves a lot of surprise incidents.
Micah (PM): Noted. See you Tue.
